study: Traditional weighted maximum independent set baselines on CP-SCALE-AU-L002

graph_invariants.vertex_id_definition: NPZ zero-based row index; no permutation

seed_policy.stablesolver_local_search: official binary ignores --seed; one measured canonical seed=0 run per view; time-limited output may vary between repeated runs
seed_policy.stablesolver_large_neighborhood_search: official binary ignores --seed; one measured canonical seed=0 run per view; time-limited output may vary between repeated runs
seed_policy.grasp: five independent registered seeds per view
seed_policy.simulated_annealing: five independent registered seeds per view
seed_policy.stablesolver_greedy_gwmin: one-pass official method, one measured canonical seed=0 run per view; actual early-stop runtime is reported

paired_unit: same graph_id and seed for randomized arms; StableSolver per-view score may be reused across the five C05 seeds only for arithmetic, explicitly labeled as one measured seed-ignored single-run reference

budget.clock_scope: start immediately before graph input loading; include solver preprocessing, search, solution extraction and local integer feasibility check; exclude pre-frozen benchmark format conversion, process startup and result persistence
budget.cpu_affinity: one distinct physical CPU per live position
budget.memory: per-position RLIMIT_AS 3 GiB; cloud cgroup 72 GiB; reduce concurrency if measured peak requires it

method_time_controls.grasp: native receives 900 seconds minus measured input validation/load offset and 1.5-second output reserve; outer 900-second cap
method_time_controls.simulated_annealing: native receives 900 seconds minus measured input validation/load offset and 1.5-second output reserve; outer 900-second cap
method_time_controls.stablesolver_greedy_gwmin: one-pass natural early stop under outer end-to-end 900-second cap

supplementary_budget.stablesolver_greedy_gwmin: one-pass natural early stop, capped at 900 wall seconds; report actual runtime and keep separate from full-budget search arm ranking

representation.input: exact source NPZ with no modified weights or conflicts
representation.shared_native_graph: frozen exact weighted METIS 10 and DIMACS1992 files
representation.metis_header: 37421 m 10, where m is the exact undirected NPZ edge count
representation.metis_row_i: decimal weight_ticks[i] then sorted symmetric neighbors represented by NPZ indices plus one
representation.dimacs_records: p edge 37421 m; n i+1 weight_ticks[i] for every vertex; e u+1 v+1 for every original undirected edge
representation.verification: independently reparse METIS and DIMACS and compare all 37,421 weights and the complete undirected edge set to hashed NPZ; record converter source SHA256 and both graph file SHA256 values

stablesolver_local_search.solution_ids: native certificate uses NPZ zero-based vertex IDs

stablesolver_large_neighborhood_search.solution_ids: native certificate uses NPZ zero-based vertex IDs

stablesolver_greedy_gwmin.solution_ids: native certificate uses NPZ zero-based vertex IDs

grasp.origin: independent C++ implementation in this experiment

simulated_annealing.origin: independent C++ implementation in this experiment

stablesolver_submodules.observation: git submodule status --recursive returned empty output at the frozen commit

activation_gate: freeze every source commit, binary SHA256, command line and method configuration before measured launch
verify each native solver uses exact integer node weights and at least signed 64-bit objective and intermediate weighted accumulators
verify any native one-based vertex output is converted to the original NPZ zero-based row IDs without permutation
if an official solver overflows, lacks exact weighted mode, or cannot emit an independently auditable selected set, record it as incompatible and do not count a zero-valued score
primary_outcome: final independently audited integer value_ticks, converted to contact-seconds by exact division by 1000000
trajectory_policy: timestamp actual incumbent improvements with monotonic elapsed_seconds and exact value_ticks; retain raw native logs; if a solver does not expose intermediate incumbents, report final point only and do not interpolate
audit: all NPZ SHA256 values match the prior 900-second registration
METIS and DIMACS bytes match frozen hashes and reparse to exact NPZ weights and edges
each randomized arm has exactly one result for each of 40 graph-seed positions and each StableSolver arm, including supplementary greedy-gwmin, has one measured seed=0 result per view
source, binary, command, time limit, seed and CPU configuration match frozen registration
selected zero-based IDs are unique, in range and pairwise nonadjacent
sum of original NPZ int64 weights selected, in a wider accumulator, equals reported value_ticks
record failures and incompatibilities explicitly; do not substitute zero or carry another method's incumbent
only complete audited-valid arms enter the overall mean comparison (8-of-8 official seed-ignored single runs or 40-of-40 randomized); do not describe reused official scores as independent runs

outputs.isolation: never write into the completed C05 360-second or 900-second result roots

data_lineage: Eight constraint views of one physical contact source; views are not independent datasets.
